goal: Review the implementation against the approved Developer AI Code Improvement plan and maintainability requirements.
decisions: The feature is isolated from the debugging advisor by its own feature key, prompt task, normalizer, action, UI, and tests.
The normalizer uses a strict schema so the UI receives only bounded categories and fields.
No database migration or workflow mutation is needed because review results are ephemeral.
acceptance_criteria: Assigned Developer access is enforced server-side.
Generated code is advisory and inert.
Existing shared gateway limits and usage records are reused.
remaining_work: Complete database and manual browser verification before release.
